info.name: Local Services Marketplace API
info.description:
REST API for the Local Services Marketplace (Kaarigar).

1. Run **Auth** first: it stores JWTs in collection variables.
2. Folders run top-to-bottom as an end-to-end booking workflow.

Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:5080) and the demo credentials in the collection variables.

exec: pm.test("Returns a JWT for a Customer", () => { pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql("Customer"); });

item.name: Login with a wrong password is rejected
Public registration cannot create an Admin

exec: pm.test("Provider is verified and has services", () => { pm.expect(p.isVerified).to.be.true; pm.expect(p.services.length).to.be.above(0); });
// Use the latest slots so they are well outside the 2-hour cancellation window.
pm.test("Problem details lists the address field", () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json().errors)).to.include("Address"));
pm.test("Location header points to the booking", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.include("/api/bookings/" + b.id));

item.name: Same slot again is a conflict (409)
Booked slot is no longer offered

exec: pm.test("Moved and back to Pending", () => pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("Pending"));

item.name: Second review on the same booking is a conflict (409)

exec: pm.test("Only this provider's bookings", () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(b => pm.expect(b.providerName).to.eql("Rohit Verma")));
